clue.text: Support rebellious Roger raised for dissentient people

parts.note: a splint is a rigid support bound to a broken limb

indicators.note: rebels refuse to stay in line, so the letters of the name are thrown out of order

parts.note: something raised is up

explanation.surface: Backing a rebellious man called Roger who has been promoted, on behalf of dissenters.
explanation.definitionFit: A breakaway faction is formed by members who dissent from the main body.

clue.text: He's too infantile to be brave

definitions.text: He's too infantile to be brave

parts.words: He's too infantile to be brave
parts.note: a brave is a Native American warrior; the one described is still a baby carried on its mother's back

explanation.definitionFit: A Native American infant is too young yet to become a warrior, or brave.

clue.text: Flag in all the colours of the rainbow

definitions.meaning: the yellow flag is a wild plant of this genus

definitions.text: all the colours of the rainbow
definitions.meaning: the goddess of the rainbow in Greek myth, whose name also gives iridescent

explanation.surface: A banner showing every colour of the rainbow.
explanation.definitionFit: Flag is a plant name for a wild species of the genus, and the Greek rainbow goddess bore the same name.

clue.text: Aim to house the elderly that's a disaster

indicators.note: to house something is to hold it within, so one word sits inside another

parts.note: to aim at something is to try for it
the elderly are the aged

explanation.surface: Trying to provide homes for old people ends in catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A tragedy is a calamity, a terrible event.

clue.text: About a hundred dash for lounge

parts.note: re means about or concerning
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a dash is a short line

explanation.surface: Roughly a hundred sprints to the sitting room.
explanation.definitionFit: To lounge is to lie back lazily, to lean at ease.

clue.text: Pity the woman!

definitions.meaning: an old word for compassion, surviving in ruthless
a girl's name, that of the Moabite in the Old Testament book

explanation.surface: An exclamation of sympathy for some poor woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruthless means without compassion, and a biblical heroine carries the same name.

clue.text: Honourable, genteel, quiet Conservatives

parts.note: U means upper-class, as in the old U and non-U distinction
p, piano, is the musical direction to play quietly
the political right are the conservatives

explanation.surface: A list of virtues: honourable, refined, reserved Tories.
explanation.definitionFit: An upright person is honest and of good principle.

clue.text: He bars roans, Ai, as they may be as mounts

indicators.note: the letters are taken as they might be arranged, a cue to rework them

parts.note: an ai is a three-toed sloth, used here only for its letters

explanation.surface: He keeps out roan horses and a sloth, as they might serve as steeds.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of HE BARS ROANS AI give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Desert-bred horses from the Middle East are prized riding animals.

clue.text: Where one form of transport must give way to another

definitions.text: Where one form of transport must give way to another

parts.words: Where one form of transport must give way to another
parts.note: the place where a road meets a railway line on the flat and cars must stop for trains

explanation.definitionFit: At a railway crossing on the same plane as the road, motor traffic waits while trains pass.

clue.text: Note the policeman going outside left one a copy

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: one piece goes around the outside of another

parts.note: PC is a police constable
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A note: the constable who went out left behind a duplicate.
explanation.definitionFit: A replica is an exact reproduction of something.

clue.text: Set a little house by a lake

parts.note: a cot is a small cottage
Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America

explanation.surface: A small cottage on the shore of a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A coterie is a select circle of people, a clique.

clue.text: Sound upsurge in the country's economy

definitions.meaning: a period of rapid economic growth

explanation.surface: A healthy rise in the nation's economy.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a loud hollow noise and a sudden period of prosperity.

clue.text: Relinquish key-term's over

parts.note: D is a musical key

indicators.note: 'over' turns the word for a term the other way round

parts.note: a term is a period of time

explanation.surface: Giving up once the important term is finished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' signals a reversal of the word for a term; 'key-term's' reads as one word in the surface but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To demit is to resign or give up an office.

clue.text: The monster will make a certain amount of progress

indicators.text: will make a certain amount of
indicators.note: only a portion of the following word is taken, a run of its inner letters

explanation.surface: The beast is going to advance a little.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogre is a man-eating giant of fairy tales.

clue.text: Direct return to the border

indicators.note: to return is to go back, so the whole phrase is read from the end

parts.note: taken as written
a lip is the edge or rim of something

explanation.surface: Instructions to go back to the frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: One indicator, 'return', turns the whole phrase 'to the border' round rather than a single word.
explanation.definitionFit: To pilot is to steer or guide.

clue.text: Fall over bearing trash

parts.note: to trip is to stumble and fall
E, east, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: Stumbling while carrying rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe is slang for worthless nonsense.

clue.text: A pleasing feature can be arranged any time

indicators.note: letters that can be arranged are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A nice facility can be booked whenever you like.
explanation.definitionFit: An amenity is a desirable or useful facility of a place.

clue.text: After some hesitation the renegade in charge sees vagrant

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitating
a rat is a deserter or turncoat

explanation.surface: After a pause, the turncoat in command spots a tramp.
explanation.definitionFit: Vagrant can mean wandering or unpredictable, like something erratic.

clue.text: Offer to carry on

definitions.meaning: to hold something out is to proffer it

explanation.surface: A proposal to continue.
explanation.definitionFit: Both to extend a thing as an offer and to persist in resisting.

clue.text: A politician who can transcribe into braille

indicators.note: transcribing turns one script into another, so the letters are rewritten in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A politician able to render text in braille.
explanation.definitionFit: A Liberal is a member of the Liberal party.

clue.text: Hardy heroine with time for a bit mosaic

parts.note: Tess of the d'Urbervilles is Thomas Hardy's novel and its heroine
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Thomas Hardy's heroine spends a while on a piece of mosaic.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Hardy was an English novelist; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tessera is one small tile of a mosaic.

clue.text: The singer, getting a concession, rushed round

parts.note: a sop is something given to placate
to have rushed is to have ran, here ran as past tense
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: The vocalist, granted a favour, hurried round.
explanation.definitionFit: A soprano is a singer with the highest voice range.

clue.text: Usable if fresh, that's official

indicators.note: the letters are usable in a different arrangement, a cue to rework them

explanation.surface: Food that is fresh can be used, officially.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheriff is a county or legal officer.

clue.text: Attended closely to a couple of pages and told stories

parts.note: pp is the abbreviation for pages
telling stories is a euphemism for fibbing

explanation.surface: Concentrated on two pages and fibbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Applying oneself to a task means giving it close attention.

clue.text: Dress in the right order

parts.note: OBE, Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: Getting dressed in the correct sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: A robe is a long loose garment.

clue.text: A skinhead, with female following goes pale

parts.note: the head of the word skin is S
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A thug, with a woman behind him, turns white.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' puts the hen after the other pieces; 'goes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashen means grey-faced, as pale as ashes.

clue.text: Gibbons, for example

parts.note: the capital letter suggests people called Gibbons, but these are the long-armed primates

explanation.definitionFit: Gibbons are small tailless primates of South-East Asia.

clue.text: They are non-returnable cards

parts.note: cards here are players of high value, and in tennis a serve the receiver cannot return is called by the same name

explanation.definitionFit: A tennis serve the opponent fails to touch scores outright, and the top playing cards share its name.

clue.text: Found worthless

definitions.meaning: to found is to establish, to set something on a footing

explanation.surface: Discovered to be of no value.
explanation.definitionFit: Both to ground or establish something and to be mean or of low worth.

clue.text: This may well trouble the listeners

definitions.text: This may well trouble the listeners

parts.words: This may well trouble the listeners
parts.note: listeners are not an audience but the organs of hearing, which can ache

explanation.definitionFit: A pain in the ear afflicts the organs that listen.

clue.text: A European will give it a secure backing

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word for secure runs in reverse

parts.note: to nail something down is to secure it

explanation.surface: A European will give support to make it safe.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian is a native of Italy.

clue.text: Seed is finally scattered in a delightful place

indicators.note: seed scattered is strewn about, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: In the end the seed is sown in a lovely spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Elysian Fields were the paradise of Greek myth, so the phrase means any blissful place.
